integrity: All mathematical definitions, proof steps, assumptions and limits appear in RESULT.md; verifiable standalone code computes finite examples from Hamiltonian-path weights and filtered chain matrices. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires exactly two equilateral clusters with \(u,v\ge2\) and \(B>(\max\{u,v\}-1)\delta\); does not cover arbitrary ultrametrics or the ordered simplicial-set construction. Independent external audit and validation have not been performed. Finite computational checks supplement but do not replace the general proof.
title: Complete length–Rips persistence of well-separated two-level ultrametrics
